versions.text: Criterion: Verify that longitudinal control forces in sideslips are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.4.1 Longitudinal control forces in sideslips. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

Standard: The longitudinal control forces in sideslip are no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Forces in Sideslips paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the longitudinal control force required to maintain a constant air speed in steady sideslips as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Forces in Sideslips paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the longitudinal control force required to maintain a constant air speed in steady sideslips as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Forces in Sideslips paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the longitudinal control force required to maintain a constant air speed in steady sideslips as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Forces in Sideslips paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
